workloadBoundaries.independent-parse-load/1000: setup store/sheet/numeric input; timed 1000 setFormula calls (parse, FormulaEntry metadata, store insertion); correctness recompute/read is untimed
workloadBoundaries.error-propagation/1000: setup 1001 setFormula calls; timed first recompute only; read check untimed
workloadBoundaries.scalar-edit-affects-1000/1000: setup 1000 formulas plus initial recompute; timed setNumber plus incremental recompute; read check untimed
workloadBoundaries.shared-range-edit/1000: setup 1000 SUM(range) formulas plus initial recompute; timed setNumber plus incremental recompute; read check untimed
workloadBoundaries.removed-sheet-ref/1000: setup sheets, 1000 cross-sheet formulas, initial recompute; timed removeSheet only (invalidation/recompute inside API); read check untimed
workloadBoundaries.wide-fan-out-edit/1000: setup 1000 scalar formulas plus initial recompute; timed setNumber plus incremental recompute; read check untimed
workloadBoundaries.wide-fan-out-edit/100000: setup 100000 scalar formulas plus initial recompute; timed setNumber plus incremental recompute; read check untimed

bootstrap.statistic: candidate percentile / baseline percentile - 1, expressed as percent
bootstrap.pairing: paired alternating rounds; bootstrap resamples whole rounds with replacement
